_readme: Expected outcome of importing each fixture on the site. 'expect' is the DESIRED behaviour. 'parseBug' marks entries where today's parser/validator does not meet it (the automated test is reported as TODO until fixed). 'renderBug' marks inputs that parse fine but draw incorrectly; see qa/TEST_PLAN.md. Every file in this folder must have an entry (enforced by zing-plot-web/tests/fixtures.test.mjs).
